stem: Which sentence from the selection best shows that people recognize Fotheringham's accomplishments?

options.label: A
options.text: He has also been interviewed on CNN and earned a spot on the ABC news segment "Person of the Week."

options.label: B
options.text: He likes to show these young people that a wheelchair can be a toy as well as a tool.

options.label: C
options.text: He also performs on extreme-sports tours, racing down huge ramps and flying into the air to entertain crowds.

options.label: D
options.text: Today Fotheringham competes in extreme-sports contests, where he's almost always the only athlete in a wheelchair.
